instructions.selectPiece: Select a Tetris piece from below, then click on the grid to place it.
instructions.placePiece: Click a target cell to place {{piece}}. Use rotate button to turn.

errors.cannotPlace: Cannot place here - piece overlaps or extends outside target!

geometryInsight.title: Geometry Insight
geometryInsight.message: You used spatial reasoning to tessellate pieces. This skill is essential in architecture, engineering, and coding!

hints.rotationTip: Try rotating pieces with this button or press R!

tetrominoTip.title: Tetromino Tip
tetrominoTip.message: Each piece covers exactly 4 squares. The total target area is always a multiple of 4!

strategy.title: Strategy
strategy.message: Fill corners first - they have fewer valid placements, which simplifies later decisions.

spatialThinking.title: Spatial Thinking
spatialThinking.message: Practice mentally rotating pieces before clicking. This builds spatial reasoning skills!

spatialReasoning.title: Spatial Reasoning
spatialReasoning.tip: Try visualizing how each piece would look rotated before placing it.

fillCornersFirst.title: Fill Corners First
fillCornersFirst.tip: Corners have fewer valid placements, so fill them early to reduce complexity.

areaConservation.title: Area Conservation
areaConservation.tip: The total area of all pieces always equals the target area. Use this to verify your solution.

rotationMatters.title: Rotation Matters
rotationMatters.tip: Most Tetris pieces can be placed in 4 different orientations. Experiment with all of them!

editor.title: Custom Level Editor
editor.instructions: Click and drag to draw the target shape, then select pieces to use
editor.noTargetCells: Draw at least one target cell
editor.pieceMismatch: Pieces have {{pieces}} cells but target has {{cells}} cells
